name: Vector Space Span Translation
description: Translate the graph connectivity problem into a linear algebra problem of finding a minimal-cost subset of given vectors (of the form $e_u - e_v$) that spans a target set of difference vectors. This removes all graph framing (vertices, edges, connections) and replaces it with vector space terminology (basis vectors, linear span). It forces the model to recognize the structural equivalence between linear independence of these specific vectors and acyclicity in graphs to achieve the optimal O(n) time complexity, punishing models that fall back to standard O(n^3) matrix operations.
